title: Linear Issue Event Daily Event Volume
dataSources: RescueTime activity (`rescuetime:activity`), Apple/Android screen-time exports (`screentime:usage`), GitHub events (`github:personal`), habit-tracker logs (`habit:entry`), calendar/todo exports.
app: Screen-time / RescueTime exports, GitHub personal activity, habit/journal trackers, and calendar feeds via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=linear:issue
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(team_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Linear issue event events land each day and how many distinct team values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Linear issue event records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct team values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It combines how much Linear issue event activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
